channel.description: Find the right tool at the right price.

item.title: OXO Grill Brush with Replaceable Head Drops to $24.99 at Amazon
item.description: The OXO Outdoor Coiled Grill Brush features a coiled stainless steel head that effectively cleans grill grates and includes a replaceable head for extended use. This deal brings the price down to $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: eufyCam S4 4K 360° Camera with E10 Display for $460
item.description: The eufyCam S4 is a 4K security camera with 360° tracking, bundled with the eufy 8-inch Smart Display E10. This bundle is available for $459.98 after a $140 discount with code WS24T8172T87A0, with free shipping.

item.title: Bosch 12V Max Green-Beam Cross-Line Laser Kit for $209
item.description: This laser kit includes a green-beam cross-line laser that operates on a 12V Max battery or AA batteries for flexibility. The deal applies a $240 discount at checkout, bringing the price to $209 with free shipping.

item.title: Greenworks 40V 16" Cordless Mower with Battery and Charger for $195.50
item.description: This Greenworks 40V cordless push mower includes a 16-inch cutting deck, a 4.0Ah battery, and a charger. The price is $195.50 after applying coupon code SDNEWSLETTER15, with free shipping.

item.title: VEVOR 35A Smart Battery Charger Drops to $42.03 with Coupon
item.description: The VEVOR 35A smart battery charger is compatible with LiFePO4 lithium and lead-acid batteries. It is currently available for $42.03 after applying coupon code VVUSTOP at checkout.

item.title: SPIRE 550X 6-Burner Gas Grill at Costco for $439.99
item.description: The SPIRE 550X is a six-burner gas grill with 762 square inches of total cooking space. Costco is offering it for $439.99 with free delivery, reflecting a $100 manufacturer's savings valid through September 7, 2026.

item.title: Cuisinart 5-Piece Grill Tool Set for $9.91 at Sam's Club
item.description: This Cuisinart grill tool set includes five essential pieces for outdoor cooking. The set is priced at $9.91 at Sam's Club, with free shipping available on orders over $50 for Plus members.

item.title: DESLOC WiFi Smart Lock with Fingerprint and App Control for $45.99
item.description: The DESLOC D110 Plus is a smart door lock with WiFi connectivity, fingerprint recognition, and app control. It is currently available for $45.99 after applying coupon code IH5K6V3F, reflecting a 50% discount from the original price.

item.title: EGO 880 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower with Two Batteries for $307
item.description: The EGO Power+ LB8803-2 is a cordless electric leaf blower delivering 880 CFM of air volume. This package includes two batteries and is priced at $307 with free shipping, which is a decent price for the blower and batteries.

item.title: Toro 21" 60V Self-Propelled Mower with 6.0Ah Battery, $299 at Lowe's
item.description: The Toro Recycler 21" 60V Max Flex-Force Self-Propelled Battery Walk Mower includes a 6.0Ah battery. Lowe's is offering it for $299 with free shipping, though availability may vary by location.

item.title: Greenworks 40V 16in Push Mower with Battery and Charger for $229.99
item.description: This cordless push mower runs on a 40V 4.0 Ah battery and includes a charger. It is available at Amazon for $229.99, down from the regular price of $349.99.

item.title: Greenworks 60V Self-Propelled Mower with Two Batteries for $439.99
item.description: This cordless lawn mower features a 60V brushless motor and includes two 4.0 Ah batteries. It offers a 21-inch cutting deck and is self-propelled for easier maneuvering. The deal price is $439.99, down from the regular price of $699.99.

item.title: Traeger Pro Series 22 Pellet Grill Drops to $389 at Home Depot
item.description: The Traeger Pro Series 22 is a wood pellet grill with a large cooking area, ideal for outdoor cooking. Starting August 27, Home Depot will offer it for $389, a notable price for this model.

item.title: Char-Broil 4-Burner Gas Grill at Lowe's for $299
item.description: The Char-Broil FlavorMax Performance Series is a 4-burner liquid propane gas grill in black. Lowe's is currently offering this grill for $299.

item.title: DESLOC B200 Smart Lock with 2 Handles for $48
item.description: The DESLOC B200 is a smart door lock with fingerprint, Bluetooth app, keypad, and fob access. It includes two lever handles and offers features like auto-lock and remote access sharing. The deal is $48 with free shipping.

item.title: UBeesize 65x48-inch Fireproof Grill Mat for $24.99
item.description: This large under-grill mat from UBeesize measures 65 by 48 inches and is designed for use under outdoor grills, fire pits, and indoor fireplaces. It is double-sided, fireproof, oil-proof, and waterproof, offering protection for your patio or floor. The mat is available for $24.99.

item.title: Cuisinart Sauce Pot and Basting Brush Set for $14.99
item.description: This set includes a 16 oz. stainless steel sauce pot and a silicone basting brush, designed for grilling and BBQ. It is easy to clean and suitable for smoking and grilling. The set is available for $14.99.

item.title: OXO 6-Piece Grilling Prep and Carry System on Sale at Walmart
item.description: The OXO Grilling Prep and Carry System is a comprehensive 6-piece set designed for grilling tasks. It is currently available at Walmart for $32.42, with free shipping for Walmart+ members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Greenworks 60V Cordless Edger with Battery and Charger for $189.98
item.description: The Greenworks 60V cordless edger features an 8-inch steel blade for clean lawn edges. This deal includes a 2.0 Ah battery and charger for $189.98.

item.title: Portable Charcoal Grill with Wooden Handle for $33.96
item.description: This 15-inch portable charcoal grill features a wooden handle and a secure lid lock, making it easy to transport for picnics, beach trips, and other outdoor activities. The grill is currently available for $33.96.

item.title: Expert Grill Extra Large Grilling Shears for $0.97 at Walmart
item.description: These extra-large grilling shears from Expert Grill are designed for cutting meat and vegetables. Walmart is offering them for $0.97, with free store pickup available.

item.title: Combo Grill with Gas and Charcoal Sides for $399.99
item.description: This combo grill features a 2-burner propane gas grill and a charcoal grill positioned side by side, allowing for versatile cooking options. The deal includes a cover and is priced at $399.99.

item.title: Milwaukee Packout 5-Compartment Organizer for $31.98 or Less
item.description: The Milwaukee Packout 5-compartment small parts organizer is a durable tool case designed to keep fasteners and small parts organized. Zoro is offering a coupon that brings the price down to $31.98 or less, with free shipping on orders over $50. A 10-compartment version is also available for $47.98 or less.

item.title: Hammersmith Torch Lighter and V-Cutter Combo for $34.99
item.description: This combo pack includes a triple flame torch lighter and a V-cutter. It is priced at $34.99 after a coupon code, with free shipping.

item.title: DESLOC B200 8-in-1 Fingerprint Smart Lock with 2 Handles for $47.99
item.description: The DESLOC B200 is an 8-in-1 smart lock that offers multiple access methods including fingerprint, code, and key. This deal includes two elegant round lever handles and is priced at $47.99 with a promo code at checkout.

item.title: Greenworks 80V 21" Push Mower with Two Batteries and Charger for $400
item.description: This is a battery-powered push mower with a 21-inch cutting deck, part of Greenworks' 80V line. The deal includes the mower, two 2.0Ah batteries, and a charger, all for $399.99 with free shipping from Walmart.

item.title: Klein Tools Snap Ring Pliers Set with Interchangeable Heads for $19.98
item.description: This set from Klein Tools includes convertible snap ring pliers with interchangeable heads, allowing for both internal and external ring applications. The deal price is $19.98 at Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: ThermoPro Grill Light with 10 LEDs Drops to $13 at Walmart
item.description: This ThermoPro outdoor grill light features 10 LEDs, a 360-degree adjustable mount, three brightness levels, and an energy-saving button. It is available for $13 with free shipping at Walmart.

item.title: Coghlan's Deluxe Broiler with Extendable Handle for $15 at Walmart
item.description: This broiler from Coghlan's features a chrome-plated construction and an extendable handle for safe use over a grill. It offers a 9x13-inch grill surface, suitable for outdoor cooking. The deal is available for $15 with free shipping for Walmart+ members or free pickup where available.

item.title: AOWOO 2-Pack Grilling Aprons for $9.89 with Free Shipping
item.description: This deal offers a 2-pack of AOWOO unisex aprons suitable for grilling or kitchen use. Each apron is adjustable, waterdrop resistant, and features three pockets. Priced at $9.89 with free shipping for Walmart+ members.
